newsitem.title: GERMANY: Details on Romania DM eurobond due next week - lead.
newsitem.headline: Details on Romania DM eurobond due next week - lead.

text.p: Details on an exact launch date and spread pricing for Romania's first mark-denominated eurobond will be released early next week, joint lead manager Deutsche Bank said on Wednesday.
Romanian central bank governor Mugur Constantin Isarescu, speaking at a roadshow for the issue in Frankfurt, said he expected the bond to be issued in early June, but declined to give an exact date.
A spokesman for Deutsche Bank, which is co-lead managing the issue with Credit Suisse First Boston, added however that he expected more details to be released soon.
"We will give more information at the beginning of next week," he said. "I think that tells you what we mean by 'early June'".
Earlier, Isarescu said the bond, which will be rated BB minus by Standard and Poor's and Ba3 by Moody's, will have a maturity of five years.
